summary: Completed e2e testing of dual-mode AI workout generation feature. All features working correctly: 1) Two generation modes (tipo_treino/periodo) in AI dialog, 2) Split badges on plan cards, 3) Backend API for periodo-mode generation, 4) GET /api/workout-plans returns plans with split_type and generation_mode fields

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dual-mode AI workout generation feature fully tested. Key test points: 1) Login at /login, 2) Navigate to /workouts, 3) Click Fichas tab to see plan cards with split badges (Treino AB, A Superior/B Inferior, 4x/sem, 1 sem), 4) Open 'Gerar com IA' dialog - has two tabs: 'Por Tipo de Treino' (split selector AB/ABC/ABCD/ABCDE, muscle group config, days/week, cycle weeks, cardio toggle) and 'Por Período' (duration selector, muscle groups, AI info box). Backend periodo-mode generation takes ~15-20s, tipo_treino mode takes 60-90s (avoid testing in automation).

features_tested.periodo_tab_elements: PASS - Duration selector, muscle groups selector, AI info box all present
features_tested.split_badges_on_cards: PASS - Plans show 'Treino AB' badge with purple styling, split config summary (A Superior, B Inferior), training frequency (4x/sem), cycle duration (1 sem)
features_tested.backend_periodo_generation: PASS - POST /api/workout-plans/generate with generation_mode='periodo' returns success with plan data
